people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
translations.bsb: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
translations.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
